trials.claim: Includes all future Pro, Autopilot and Team plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Pro (Tier 1), Autopilot (Tier 2), Team (Tiers 3, 4) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The terms only generally reserve the right to change features and apply fair-use limits; they do not specifically show lifetime buyers are excluded from future Pro, Autopilot, or Team updates, and no supporting exhibit is provided.

exhibits.quote: We may add, change, or remove features over time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to remove features, undermining promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime, AppSumo, or other promotional offers are subject to their specific terms and fair-use limits.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime deal is limited by separate terms and fair-use limits, not unlimited future plans.

trials.claim: Offers AppSumo full refund window of 60 days
trials.claimQuote: You have AppSumo's full refund window [60 days].
trials.reasoning: The binding terms state paid subscription and lifetime plans have only a 14-day money-back guarantee, directly conflicting with the claimed 60-day refund window; one review does not outweigh those terms.

exhibits.quote: Paid plans (subscription and lifetime) include a 14-day money-back guarantee: request a refund within 14 days of your purchase and we will return it in full.
exhibits.argument: Official terms allow only 14 days for refund, contradicting claimed 60-day window.

exhibits.quote: I am on Tier 3, and for the price, with a 60 day refund window, it is an easy yes.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase includes a 60 day refund window.

trials.claim: Connects Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton and any IMAP account into a single prioritized view
trials.claimQuote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton, and any IMAP account into a single prioritized view
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton, and IMAP, and a buyer confirms multiple accounts were pulled into one inbox; one connection-trouble report and a generic third-party disclaimer do not materially undercut this.

exhibits.quote: I'm having trouble connecting my Proton Mail account.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Proton connection failure, undermining claim all providers connect.

exhibits.quote: We are not responsible for third-party services, and they may change or restrict their APIs in ways that affect the Services.
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims responsibility when third-party mail APIs restrict connectivity.

exhibits.quote: Every provider (Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton, IMAP)
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists the same six provider types as supporting the claim.

exhibits.quote: I connected 3 Gmail accounts and 1 Yahoo account, and AI Emaily pulled them all into one inbox.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms multiple accounts are pulled into one unified inbox.

trials.claim: Consolidates threads with smart tabs and VIP inbox to surface important mail first
trials.claimQuote: Consolidate threads with smart tabs and a VIP inbox so the mail that matters surfaces first
trials.reasoning: Two buyers consistently report filters and AI misclassifying spam as important or failing to catch obvious spam, materially undercutting the claim that important mail reliably surfaces first.

exhibits.quote: The filters haven’t always worked correctly, and the AI has misinterpreted messages—for example, treating spam as something that needed attention and misclassifying an email as a potential client enquiry.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports mis-sorting where spam surfaces as important, contradicting surfacing important mail first.

exhibits.quote: AI spam filter needs much work, as it's not picking up very obvious spam.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports spam filter fails on obvious spam, undermining consolidation claim.

exhibits.quote: highlights important conversations, and drafts replies in your voice—so you never waste time digging through email.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the product highlights important conversations to save digging time.

exhibits.quote: I like how my inbox is focused on important emails while my other ones are tucked away and categorized for me to sift through when I have time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms inbox focuses on important emails while others are categorized away.

trials.claim: Search across all accounts with AI search by meaning not just keywords
trials.claimQuote: Search across all accounts with smart AI search that finds messages by meaning, not just keywords
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports search was not finding emails, and another was told only the past year is synchronized, directly limiting the claimed search across all accounts and mail.

exhibits.quote: However, I then noticed that the search function wasn't finding my emails.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports search fails to find emails, contradicting cross-account search claim.

exhibits.quote: I was informed that only emails from the past year are synchronized.
exhibits.argument: Search is limited to one year of sync, so it cannot search across all mail.

themes.summary: Several buyers say core email functions are buggy, from broken forwarding and zoom to misclassified mail and cluttered UI.

hits.quote: The interface is buggy, feels cluttered and unintuitive, with overly complicated menus and several missing features.
I forwarded my wife's boarding pass at the airport and she never got the QR code boarding pass graphic she needed
AI spam filter needs much work, as it's not picking up very obvious spam.
The filters haven’t always worked correctly, and the AI has misinterpreted messages—for example, treating spam as something that needed attention

themes.summary: Several buyers, including unhappy ones, say support is fast, helpful and implements requested fixes.

hits.quote: the support is A+ 5 stars all the way
Support was helpful and even quickly implemented some of the requested features.
Support is fantastic! I came across a couple glitches that were quickly resolved within a day or two.
The good news is that support has been quite helpful when I’ve raised issues.

themes.summary: Several happy buyers say the app cleans up multi-account inboxes, organizes mail and drafts useful replies.

hits.quote: The interface is clean and easy to navigate and switching between email accounts is a breeze.
I connected 3 Gmail accounts and 1 Yahoo account, and AI Emaily pulled them all into one inbox.
First of all, the UI is impeccable, so right out of the gate, I was wowed.

The desktop and mobile apps are wrappers, not OS native.
a native app for mobile and Mac, the way teh other email clients have it.
